description: Montana — In a candid Q&A with Montana Public Radio, Independent candidate Dr. Mike Eisenhauer explains why he’s running: an unshackled representative can be a true problem-solver instead of adding to Washington’s gridlock. The retired Army Colonel and cardiologist highlights his structured, evidence-based approach to issues, drawing from 24 years of military service and 35 […]
title: Q&A: Michael Eisenhauer on Montana Public Radio - Eisenhauer for Congress
